role.roleTitle: Credit Risk Reporting Analyst, Commercial Lending

evidence.text: Credit risk reporting analyst in a commercial bank's credit risk reporting team for four years, building and running the monthly portfolio risk reports from the lending data under the bank's reporting standard.
Reconciled the monthly reports to the general ledger with finance, with the reconciliation sign-off recorded each month in the reporting log.

Investigated the report movements the credit committee questioned and presented the walk-through to the committee secretariat each month; the secretariat's minutes record the questions asked and the explanations accepted for the twenty-three walk-throughs I presented.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of investigation and presentation

evidence.text: Coordinated the lending data changes with the data platform team through the data change log, recording which validations were mine and which were the platform team's.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of coordination and responsibility boundaries

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each monthly report.
